title: Require Domain Entrypoint Shape
forbids: domain root entrypoints that compose contracts or routers, execute runtime code, or expose owners outside the domain model and module tree
why: A domain root index is one declaration-only public barrel. Contract identity and subdomain composition belong in contract.ts, runtime composition belongs in router.ts, and public vocabulary remains owned by model or semantic modules.
remediate: Default-re-export ./contract.js and keep any additional exports explicit and named from ./model/** or ./modules/**. Move defineDomain composition to contract.ts and router composition to router.ts.
message: Domain index.ts must be a declaration-only barrel over the contract plus explicit model or module exports.
